_documentation.model_purpose: CBOE Equity Put/Call Ratio (CBOE_PCR) 3-Day Fast Kinematic Velocity Stochastic Matrix
_documentation.return_formula: R_net = (P_ftt / P_t0) - 1.0 - friction (25bps in panic PCR > 1.0, 10bps standard)

field_glossary.n: Sample size in this exact PCR stereotype
field_glossary.n_pos: Exact number of positive barrier touch outcomes in this specific condition
field_glossary.n_neg: Exact number of negative barrier touch outcomes in this specific condition
field_glossary.p_bull: Pure exclusive probability target threshold is hit first in this exact condition
field_glossary.p_bear: Pure exclusive probability stop threshold is hit first in this exact condition
field_glossary.e_ret_max: Pure exclusive average net return when MAX threshold is hit in this exact condition
field_glossary.e_ret_min: Pure exclusive average net return when MIN threshold is hit in this exact condition
field_glossary.ev_net: Pure exclusive net expected value for this exact condition
field_glossary.e_days: Pure exclusive median First Touch Time (FTT) in trading days for hits in this condition
field_glossary.ftt_bull_days: Pure exclusive median FTT for bull target hits in this condition
field_glossary.ftt_bear_days: Pure exclusive median FTT for bear stop hits in this condition
